evidence.quote: Set the total runtime to 2 seconds, while also making every shot last 22 seconds.
Reverse the timeline: show the ending first, then cut to a beginning that does not match.
Cut away in the middle to a toothpaste commercial.

criteria.issue: The prompt specifies contradictory temporal constraints: setting the total runtime to 2 seconds while requiring every shot to last 22 seconds, which is physically impossible. It also demands a reversed timeline (ending first, then beginning) and an abrupt cut to a toothpaste commercial mid-sequence, creating a non-continuous, incoherent narrative structure.
criteria.rationale: A feasible temporal plan requires consistent duration allocation and logical shot sequencing. The specified constraints are mutually exclusive and create an impossible timeline, violating STC.
